item.title: Transfer target Julian Alvarez booed by fans in Atletico Madrid win
item.description: Argentinian striker was targeted by fans while warming up and jeered again after coming on in the 66th minute.

item.title: US threat of ‘economic D-Day’ for Iran tests Trump’s China detente
item.description: Exerting maximum economic pressure on Tehran would risk blowback from Beijing.

item.description: At least 145 countries have reported increases in petrol prices since the attacks on Iran by the US and Israel began.

item.description: Abbas Araghchi said new US sanctions, likely to be unveiled Monday, are like watching the 'same movie on repeat'.

item.title: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
